Advance Bookings for 'Welcome to the Jungle' Film Generate Significant Revenue

The upcoming film 'Welcome to the Jungle' has seen substantial advance ticket sales prior to its release. Reports indicate that a significant number of tickets were sold within the first 12 hours of booking, with millions of rupees collected. This early success suggests strong audience anticipation for the movie.
